notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{R}{R}.
description:
Cast Primal Adversary by paying {2}{G}.
When Primal Adversary enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} up to five times to cause up to five lands you control to become 3/3 Wolves with haste that are still lands.
Activate up to five land creatures by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3.
